title: nephrodium lanuginosum
intro: Nephrodium lanuginosum, commonly known as the Lady fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. The Lady fern has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and act as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium lanuginosum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the Lady fern include various flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
